# 90% prediction intervals on the test period (generated by `scripts/analyze_predictions.py`)

Calibration uses validation residuals only (or, for the rolling variant, errors of forecasts whose target time is not later than the forecast origin). Nominal coverage 90%. PICP = share of test hours inside the interval; width in MW; interval score = width + (2/alpha) x penalty for misses (lower is better). Demand grew between validation and test and the test year was harder to forecast, so intervals calibrated on validation are expected to under-cover; split conformal guarantees coverage only for exchangeable data.
